entity: Atlantic City Housing Authority: vacant public housing units (HUD, July 2025)
what_we_add: 339 of 1,473 units vacant without an approved reason (23.0%); highest of 91 similar-size non-Moving-to-Work authorities, 5.9x their 3.9% median; almost half at Stanley Holmes Village, 50% occupied
why: CBS Philadelphia quotes HUD's July 2025 letter: only 71.4% of units occupied against a 96% goal, same month as our file, same direction. Their 28.6% empty counts all vacancies and our 23% is the unexcused subset, so they fit; no source has the peer ranking or the Stanley Holmes share.
